newsitem.title: CHINA: Chevalier Dev proposes special dividend.
newsitem.headline: Chevalier Dev proposes special dividend.

text.p: Chevalier Development International Ltd (CDIL) said it proposed to distribute its entire 56.23 percent stake in Chevalier Construction Holdings Ltd by way of special interim dividend.
CDIL said its proposal to distribute one Chevalier Construction share for every four CDIL shares held.
The book closing period for the special interim dividend is from September 15 to 23, it said.
CDIL had said earlier it would distribute its stake in Chevalier Construction to the company shareholders in a proposed group restructuring.
Chevalier Construction shares were up HK$0.12, or 9.02 percent, to HK$0.45, and CDIL shares rose HK$0.075 to HK$3.95.
